title: Evaluation of a domain translate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $f:(\mathbb F_2)^n\to\alpha$, and let $z,x\in(\mathbb F_2)^n$. The translate of $f$ by $z$, evaluated at $x$, is $f(x+z)$.
